summary: v11.0.8.08 Enterprise Web Release: Resilient Sales & Purchase Return Loading, Instant Return Modal Prefill & Manual Input Mode, Audit Trail Resolution & Full Table Pagination Census
highlights: 1. Resilient Returns Register: Added authoritative summary recovery so existing returns (SAL-RET-2026-0002) always render immediately regardless of backend date filter formatting differences.

2. Instant Create Return Modal: Synchronously populates invoice options from in-memory sales cache, pre-selects the source invoice, ensures manual invoice input mode works smoothly, and eliminates modal freezes.
3. Audit Trail Fix: Implemented ReturnsController.showAudit() and added Audit Trail buttons to Return drawers; hardened SalesController.resolveCurrentInvoiceNo() to safely ignore placeholder dashes.
4. Returnable Line Allocation: Fixed invoice line loading to properly handle manual input and cache lookups for immediate item selection.
5. Register Pagination Census: Comprehensive audit of all 103 tables in the ERP suite, ensuring all 13 core operational registers feature 25-item pagination with 120ms debounce.
